run_build_multilingual_wordnet: run the script to download NLTK WordNet data and build multilingual synsets for all available languages
run_wordnet_english_entries: run the script to extract all English WordNet synset entries and count them
run_wordnet_lang_list: run the script to list all available WordNet languages from NLTK
run_wordnet_multilingual_synsets: run the script to collect and sort lemma names across all WordNet languages into a JSON file
run_wordnet_json_export: run the script to export multilingual WordNet synsets as a JSON file to data/metadata_source/wordnet_per_lang.json
